skill_name: Imagine a character that is the opposite of a typical superhero and create a backstory for this character.
workflow: Billy was an ordinary kid, until the day he discovered that he had extraordinary powers. Instead of being good and fighting villains like other superheroes, Billy used his powers for selfish acts like stealing candy, skipping work and avoiding exercise. Out of fear, people kept their distance from him as he used his special skills to make life easier for himself.
